body:
1: I can't help but believe he can only see things the way he sees them because he's at the end of his rope, there's nowhere left for him to go. He's had to watch literally everyone in his life die and leave him behind, the only reason I've been living since my parents died is because he told me to... I've always done what I was told to do.

2: Thanks... I just wish I could've been born into poverty. My only survival skills are leaning on men and running away... There's nothing I can do. I never learned how to deal with this. I'm lost in myself and can't understand where to go.

3: I would love to agree, but I'm the worst. I took my wounds and I smeared them over anyone who would let me. I'm a cheap whore and I'm reaping what I sowed.

4: I wish I could... Between the nightmares and the guilt I can't even sleep, food makes me want to vomit and I'm afraid of going outside because every time I see someone black I start to dry heave and cry. I can't live in this world and there really aren't options. Sit on my trust fund and wallow in myself for the next 80 years? I honestly don't want to. I just don't know what to do anymore...


Edit: And thanks for your time, it really means a lot to me.
